notes:
Literally "amount of heat." In scientific and nutritional contexts, refers to thermal energy or caloric content. In modern colloquial Japanese, increasingly used figuratively to describe someone's passion or enthusiasm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱量|ねつりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high in calories; high in passion
- {熱量|ねつりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low in calories; lacking enthusiasm
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{熱量|ねつりょう}: total caloric value
- ⟦{摂取|せっしゅ}→摂取：09322_sesshu⟧{熱量|ねつりょう}: caloric intake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カロリー→カロリー：06109_karorii⟧: calorie — the loanword, more common in everyday food/diet discussions
- ⟦{情熱|じょうねつ}→情熱：05087_jounetsu⟧: passion — the standard word for emotional passion or fervor
- ⟦{熱意|ねつい}→熱意：05088_netsui⟧: enthusiasm/eagerness — more formal, used in business and academic contexts
